executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Waterstone Resort & Marina's priority is a Reality Gap in how a distinctive part of the proposition is represented in AI answers.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Outdoor Event Space is recognized in only 9.4% of monitored answers. That is low enough to matter commercially if the attribute is part of how the hotel should win relevant traveler needs. Eau Palm Beach Resort & Spa also appears in related absent scenarios, which can compound the representation miss. Broader Scenario Presence (73.1%) and Consideration (51.3%) do not, by themselves, prove the distinctive attribute is traveling into answers.

Why It Matters. If distinctive property attributes are weakly represented, the hotel can look broadly visible while still losing the moments where its real proposition should matter. This is a representation problem first, not automatically a peer-competition program.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Wellness shows the softest Scenario Capture (50.0%), while Business Travel remains stronger (91.7%). That contrast supports a concentrated softness reading — not a uniform demand failure. Eau Palm Beach Resort & Spa most often appears when the hotel is absent (15 scenarios) — useful for source and fact reconciliation, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 38.9% (7/18 attributes). Material gaps include 24-Hour Fitness Center; Pet-Friendly; EV Charging.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on Outdoor Event Space. Verify first-party and major travel-source completeness for that attribute before treating the issue as a peer-competition problem. Confirm the attribute is stated clearly where AI systems are most likely to read it.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown. Independent Positioning (#4 of 6; Portfolio AI Presence 50.0%) uses a different denominator than Core consideration — treat it as relative portfolio context, not a second Core score.

What to Review Next. Open Reality Gap evidence for Outdoor Event Space and compare recognition cues with official property pages and high-authority travel sources. Then check a small set of related demand scenarios for whether the attribute appears when competitors are named.

biggestConstraint.headline: Not appearing consistently in AI answers
